turns.patient_response: I'm here because I'm feeling incredibly anxious and distressed about how my face looks, especially my nose. It feels completely crooked and asymmetrical, and I'm convinced it looks really ugly and noticeable to everyone. This worry has just been taking over my life, which is why I decided to seek help.

turns.patient_response: Yes, I spend hours every day checking my nose in mirrors and constantly comparing it to almost everyone I see. I also try to hide it by using heavy contouring makeup and always angling my face so people don't see it directly. When the anxiety gets too bad, I actually end up avoiding mirrors altogether just to escape looking at it.
